messages.subject: Revolution R Enterprise (Academics) Download
parts:
It is written "Revolution R Enterprise (Academics) Download" is free on Revolution Analytics official website:
http://www.revolutionanalytics.com/get-revolution-r  "FREE Downloads of Revolution R Enterprise for students, teachers and researchers."

However, during the download-ticket request process, an educational e-mail address is required.

I am a governmental official, and I am supplied a governmental e-mail address. Therefore, I did not demand educational e-mail address from Gazi University where I am performing my Master.

I am known to be a professional R developer: 
Erdogan CEVHER, "Causfinder: An R package for Systemwise Analysis of Conditional and Partial Granger Causalities", International Journal of Science and Advanced Technology, October 2014, p.6-15.

Download Address: http://www.ijsat.com/view.php?id=2014:October:Volume%204%20Issue%2010

Is there anything I can do (like sending print-screen of my page at universtiy portal)?

Best and Warm Regards,
With My Utmost Respect.

Erdogan CEVHER
The Ministry of Science, Industry and Technology, Turkey

Hi, Erdogan

I understand you have been in direct contact (via email) with Joseph Rickert.  That is the appropriate channel for queries about the Academic License.

In summary: we do accept other proof of enrolment at a university and handle these cases when they occur.

Regards

Andrie
